hook: Save one turn, blow it all the next: the Hive grows on gold kept, the Carnival spikes on gold spent.
loop: Alternate: bank gold to fire Hoard, then spend double to Splurge.
Both halves stack permanent stats; every 4 Tab pays more.
Splurge turns win fights; Gate Guard and Gravelle turn the bank into damage.

growth.line: Steady permanent +1/+1s from Hoard each turn, plus big per-4-Tab spikes on every Splurge turn.

feel.early: Spend like anyone else; Nymph and Messor grow small.
feel.mid: Save-then-splurge rhythm; Drummer makes splurge turns hit hard.
feel.late: A bank of 20 feeds Melissa and Gravelle; Cigale buffs everyone.

stars.why: Makes one turn both: a Splurge that also fires every Hoard.
Tier up gold counts double, so climbing tiers becomes a Splurge.
Your whole bank becomes one big sting, then the bee dies.

card_short.u03: Hive. Sell him for gold; he returns next turn, bigger.
card_short.u04: Hive. Hoard 4: buffs two units next to it.
card_short.u05: Carnival. End of Turn: buffs your leftmost unit per 4 Tab.
card_short.u06: Hive. Interest: 1 gold per 5 kept, up to 2.
card_short.u07: Hive. Splurge: buffs all your Hive units.
card_short.u08: Carnival. Adds a Paper Lantern spell to the shop each turn.
card_short.u09: Carnival. Start of Combat: Carnival units gain Attack per 4 Tab.
card_short.u10: Both. Grows per 4 Tab; a Hive neighbour milks her for gold.
card_short.u11: Carnival. Tier up, and later Refreshes, count double on the Tab.
card_short.u12: Hive. Hoard 6: buffs all your Hive units.
card_short.u13: Hive. Stings a neighbour's attacker for your gold, then dies.
card_short.u14: Hive. Start of Combat: blasts the biggest enemy, once per 4 gold.
card_short.u15: Carnival. Splurge: buffs your Carnival units per 4 Tab.
card_short.u16: Carnival. Splurge: hands you a Shell of your last buy.
card_short.u17: Hive. Hoard effects trigger twice, three times at 20+ gold.
card_short.u18: Carnival. Buffs all your units per 4 Tab; twice on Splurge.
card_short.u19: Carnival. Hoard counts gold plus Tab; Splurge fires Hoards again.
card_short.x01: Spell, 2 gold: aimed +2/+2 permanently; its cost goes on the Tab.
card_short.x02: Blank 1/1 copy that counts toward triples.

builds.name: The Granary
builds.line: Hold a big bank; the Hoard ladder grows, Gravelle and Guard hit.

builds.name: The Fête
builds.line: Save one turn, spend 20+ the next; Drummer, Banner Saint, Cigale spike.

builds.name: Crossing the Road
builds.line: Tithonus, Afide and Ottavia let one turn pay both halves.

liked: Reading your gold two ways, kept and spent, feels fresh to all three.
Tithonus and Tettix bend rules: Tier up becomes Splurge, spending counts as saving.
worries: Watch: Tithonus with Mother Melissa fires every Hoard four times; text still unclear.
Watch: Golden Mask-Maker makes triples on demand; Tettix plus Cigale makes Refresh huge.
changed: Every card prints its Hive or Carnival tag, so town-counting cards read clearly.
Tettix: Refresh counts double only after base gold, so saving still matters.
Long-Dark Nymph also grows on Tier up; Tithonus and Afide text made exact.
verdict: Settled at fun 6.7, distinct 7.0; ranked second of three: cleanest, flatter Hive. For fans of one huge spending turn.
